description: This file defines a React component for a modal dialog that confirms user account deletion. It utilizes React hooks, external UI components, and application-specific controllers and constants.

methods.name: closeDialog
methods.description: Callback to close the modal by setting 'deletingAccount' to false in the controller.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Button handler to close the dialog without deleting the account.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Handler to delete the user's account and close the modal.
